Hi team,

Thanks for flagging. I pulled the signup events and coupon logs for REDFREE2027 and can confirm the coupon redemption event did reach our ingestion service at 09:09 PST. However, the wallet-sync job (which aggregates grants into the UI wallet) experienced a transient retry storm after a dependent billing microservice returned 503s between 09:10–09:20; some grant records were queued and not reconciled to the wallet index.

Action taken: I've created support ticket DL-2026-089 and queued a manual credit grant for the Dataflux Labs account (grant id: GRT-20270203-334). You should see +$300 trial credits in the wallet once the DB write finishes (I've forced a reconcile). In parallel we're backfilling the missed reconciliation window.

Attached the ticket stub for your records.

ETA: credits should be visible within 10–15 minutes; if not, reply here and I will escalate to the infra on-call.

Notes for CS: this was a race caused by a short outage in billing; I'm adding an extra idempotency check to the wallet-sync job in a follow-up PR.

— Dev
Dev Patel
SRE (Payments & Ingestion), Redwood Inference
